name: ActionMenuPreview
description:
The same menu drawn statically, for documentation. `openSubmenu` shows one submenu open
beside it, and `highlight` marks a row as if hovered.
signature: <T>({ set, targets, label, openSubmenu, highlight, }: { set: ActionSet<T>; targets: readonly T[]; label: string; openSubmenu?: string; highlight?: string; }): import("react").JSX.Element

props.description: Ranges or value highlighted in a search result.

props.name: label
props.description: The visible or accessible label for this component.

props.name: set
props.description: Shared action definitions used by menus, headers and the command palette.

props.description: Selected entities passed to action visibility, enablement, confirmation and execution.
